characters.summary: Killer Croc is a massive, brutal physical combatant who relies on his superhuman strength, durability, razor-sharp teeth, and natural aquatic capabilities. He fights with vicious, feral close-quarters grappling and biting.

mechanisms: Thick, scaly reptilian hide resistant to standard firearms and blunt trauma
Advanced physical regeneration from non-lethal injuries

weaknesses: Animalistic intelligence makes him vulnerable to psychological manipulation and deception
Cold environments can slow his cold-blooded metabolism
limitations: Degenerative condition steadily erodes his human intellect, leaving him prone to reckless rage

sources.supports: Basic origin, physiological traits, and general combat style in DC continuity.

feats.claim: Ripped a bank vault door off its hinges with raw physical strength.

notableResults.note: Batman routinely exploits Croc's lack of intelligence and tactical discipline.

campaignTags.claim: Natural ability to swim rapidly and breathe or operate efficiently in deep sewer systems and aquatic environments.
Exceptional capability in swimming and underwater combat.
Adapted respiratory system allowing prolonged submersion in water.

unknowns: Exact degree of physical strength varies significantly between different comic and animated media adaptations.

characters.summary: Killer Frost is a formidable energy manipulator who absorbs heat to generate intense cold, ice constructs, and absolute zero temperatures. She prefers ranged combat, utilizing lethal frost blasts, ice slides, and freezing touch.

techniques: Heat absorption touch that instantly freezes opponents

mechanisms: Creating dense ice shields and barriers

weaknesses: Constantly requires heat sources or thermal energy to survive and maintain powers
Vulnerable to sudden physical attacks if her ice barriers are shattered
limitations: Powers cause extreme physiological distress if she goes too long without absorbing thermal energy

sources.supports: Origins, power mechanics involving thermal absorption, and combat abilities.

feats.claim: Froze an entire city block solid during a confrontation with the Justice League.

notableResults.note: Frequently clashes with Firestorm due to their opposing thermal power dynamics.

campaignTags.claim: Creates and controls ice, frost, and sub-zero temperatures.
Direct manipulation of thermal energy to freeze targets and generate structures.

unknowns: Full upper limit of her thermal absorption capacity remains undefined.

characters.summary: King Shark is a towering humanoid shark who fights as a relentless bruiser. He dominates close-range combat using immense physical strength, razor-sharp claws and teeth, and absolute fearlessness in water.
weaknesses: Low tactical intellect makes him susceptible to being outsmarted or manipulated by clever opponents
limitations: Relies almost entirely on brute force with little tactical adaptability

sources.supports: Physiology, superhuman attributes, and general combat behavior.

feats.claim: Bit through reinforced steel prison bars with a single snap.

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed by Superboy's superior speed and telekinetic shielding.

campaignTags.claim: Native marine physiology designed for deep-sea survival and combat.
Exceptional swimming speed and agility in aquatic environments.

unknowns: Exact divine ancestry (as son of the God of Sharks) is occasionally retconned across continuities.

characters.summary: Krypto is a Kryptonian canine who possesses the full spectrum of Kryptonian powers under a yellow sun. He fights with ferocious speed, heat vision, and invulnerability, combining a dog's instincts with godlike physics.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to red sun radiation which strips away his powers
limitations: Prone to typical canine distractions and loyalty tests

sources.supports: Kryptonian physiology, powers, and capabilities derived from a yellow sun.

feats.claim: Intercepted a ballistic missile in mid-air and carried it safely into the upper atmosphere.

notableResults.note: Attacked Mongul by surprise, using super-speed to disorient the tyrant.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly under yellow sun radiation.

unknowns: Intelligence level varies between standard canine intellect and near-human comprehension depending on the writer.

characters.summary: Larfleeze, the sole wielder of the Orange Light of Greed, fights by overwhelming opponents with an endless, hard-light horde of stolen identities. He is an insanely powerful, psychotic combatant who utilizes constructs for both offense and defense.

techniques: Summoning a vast army of hard-light construct minions
Stealing objects and energies through avarice constructs

mechanisms: Orange light energy aura and force fields
Swarming enemy attacks with infinite constructs

weaknesses: Obsessive greed and madness make him easily distracted by shiny objects or perceived theft of his possessions
limitations: Power source is entirely dependent on possession of his orange power battery and ring

sources.supports: Orange Lantern ring capabilities, Agent Orange status, and construct generation.

feats.claim: Fought off multiple members of the Green Lantern Corps simultaneously using an army of orange light constructs.

notableResults.note: Fought off a localized strike team single-handedly.

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the orange power ring.

unknowns: Exact age and origins prior to discovering the Orange Light entity Glomulus remain obscure.

characters.summary: Lex Luthor is a supreme intellect who fights using advanced battlesuits, high-tech weaponry, and meticulous strategic preparation. He blends high-level scientific genius with ruthless tactical execution.

mechanisms: Powered warsuit armor with energy shielding

weaknesses: Arrogance and narcissistic ego often blind him to unexpected variables in combat
Physically unaugmented without his technological gear
limitations: Warsuit requires maintenance and power sources; vulnerable if power grid is disrupted

sources.supports: Genius-level intellect, warsuit technology, and long-standing rivalry with Superman.

feats.claim: Designed and constructed a warsuit capable of trading blows with Superman.

notableResults.note: Typically defeated when Superman neutralizes his warsuit or bypasses his Kryptonite defenses.

campaignTags.claim: Master scientist and inventor capable of creating world-class technology.
Wears advanced warsuits equipped with heavy weapons and life support.
Warsuit incorporates jet propulsion and anti-gravity flight systems.
Relies entirely on advanced technology and cybernetic interfaces.

unknowns: Exact capabilities of prototype suits change frequently depending on his current corporate resources.

characters.continuity: DC Comics (Year of the Villain / Justice League)
characters.summary: Apex Lex is a transformed version of Lex Luthor endowed with Martian and apex-predator DNA by Perpetua. He fights with godlike telepathy, shape-shifting, immense physical strength, and energy projection.

techniques: Devastating energy blasts from his enhanced physiology

weaknesses: Traditional Martian vulnerabilities such as extreme heat and fire can disrupt his biology
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard human physiology and mechanical warsuits with a mutated Martian-human hybrid body possessing innate superhuman physical stats, telepathy, and shape-shifting.

sources.supports: Apex Predator transformation granted by Perpetua during Year of the Villain.

unknowns: Long-term stability of the Perpetua-induced mutation without continuous cosmic energy influx.

characters.summary: Wearing the divine armor of Apokolips, Lex Luthor acts as the ruler of Apokolips. He combines his unmatched intellect with New God technology, Omega-level energy projection, and immense armor-plated durability.
weaknesses: Reliance on Apokoliptian technology leaves him vulnerable to specialized Mother Box hacking or high-tier divine disruption.
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard human form and typical warsuits with divine Apokoliptian armor granting dominion over Apokolips and access to Omega Effect weaponry.

sources.supports: Lex Luthor claiming the mantle of Apokolips and wearing the armor of dark gods.

unknowns: The full extent of control he maintained over the Omega Effect before relinquishing the throne.

characters.summary: Lobo is an interstellar bounty hunter of unmatched brutality and near-absolute immortality. He fights with vicious chain-scythes, massive firearms, and unstoppable regenerative physical force.

mechanisms: Instantaneous cellular regeneration capable of rebuilding his entire body from a single drop of blood
Extreme physical durability against cosmic forces

weaknesses: Prone to distraction by alcohol, betting, and space-dolphins
Bounty contracts can occasionally be manipulated by clever employers
limitations: Neither heaven nor hell will accept his soul, forcing him into a state of permanent physical resurrection

sources.supports: Main Man physiology, immortality, combat skills, and weaponry.

feats.claim: Wiped out the entire Czarnian race in a single weekend using engineered plagues.

notableResults.note: Their brutal brawls typically result in massive collateral damage with neither combatant staying down.

conditional.ability: Interstellar space travel and high-speed pursuit
conditional.dependsOn: His heavily armed Space Hog motorcycle

campaignTags.claim: Ability to fly through space unassisted under his own power.
Instantly regenerates from total physical destruction and decapitation.

unknowns: Exact limits of how much punishment his regeneration can absorb before temporarily incapacitating him.
